control_flow.reason: The object route reaches unpacking, but the fixed field format selects o; the changed i guard cannot be reached by changing input bytes.

accepted.requirement: Unpack an object member with the i integer value format so a wrong-type member can reach the keyed integer diagnostic.
accepted.target_route: A selector byte followed by {"data":"x"} passes the size guard, parses as an object, enters the object branch, and could reach object-member value dispatch with the data key.
accepted.failure_condition: The old entry always uses {s?o} for that member. Its other unpack calls use o and [o!]. None selects i, and the selector byte changes dump flags only.
accepted.alternative_paths: Natural JSON input changes the value and object shape, not the fixed formats. The top-level and array calls also dispatch o; deep copy and dumping do not invoke the integer unpack guard.
